hero.subheadline: Joseph's Constructor is a family-owned, local crew that rebuilds bathrooms with custom tile showers, recessed niches and clean black and brass finishes, and takes on kitchens, floors and paint as well.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom with a wood vanity, white quartz top, brushed brass faucet and a subway tile shower with black grout, bathroom remodeling Ewing Township NJ

paragraphs: Joseph's Constructor handles bathroom remodeling in Ewing Township, NJ, and the people who hire us tend to notice the same things. One homeowner found us through a local Facebook group, asked for a quote on a bathroom, and says we took time to listen and work within their budget. Communication stayed open daily while the job ran.

Kim keeps planning and ordering simple, and our crew is known for being punctual, neat and respectful of the rest of your home. The photos on this page show the finish we aim for: crisp tile lines, recessed shower niches and fixtures set level. That first bathroom client has already brought us back for more projects.

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: Full bathroom remodels, from the vanity wall to the floor. In one recent bath we installed a gray double vanity with a quartz top, matte black faucets and a lighted mirror, set over large marble-look floor tile. Bathroom renovation is the job our Google reviewers mention most.

image.alt: Gray double vanity with a white quartz top, matte black faucets and a backlit rectangular mirror

items.name: Tiled showers and niches
items.blurb: Walk-in showers built with large white wall tile, recessed niches lined in gray and black hex mosaic, a matching mosaic floor, a corner bench and a linear drain. Each niche gets a slim black edge, so the shelves line up cleanly with the tile around them.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with white wall tile, two hex mosaic niches, a tiled corner bench and a matte black handheld shower

items.name: Kitchen renovations
items.blurb: Kitchens are part of our whole-home work. One family's renovation took a little over two weeks and covered the kitchen along with flooring, painting, new doors and a new railing. They say Kim was super communicative and walked them through each step of the process.

items.name: Flooring
items.blurb: New floors go in on their own or as part of a bigger job. The bathroom shown here got large marble-look tile laid wall to wall and finished with a clean white baseboard. Flooring was also one of the trades in a client's recent multi-room renovation.

image.alt: Bathroom with new large marble-look floor tile, a white bifold closet door and a window with blinds

items.name: Painting, doors and railings
items.blurb: The finishing work that makes a house feel done: fresh paint, new interior doors and new stair railings. A client who had all three done alongside a new kitchen and floors says the crew was amazing, punctual and super respectful of their space throughout.

why_choose_us.h2: Why Ewing homeowners hire Joseph's Constructor

items.title: Family owned and local
items.text: A client who found us through a local Facebook group calls it a bonus that we are family owned and local. The owners answer their Google reviews personally and thank each client by name.

items.title: Communication every day
items.text: Clients say communication was kept open on a regular, daily basis as needed, and that Kim walked them through each step. Questions and change requests get patient, professional answers.

items.title: A tidy, respectful crew
items.text: Reviews describe a crew that is punctual, efficient and extremely neat, and considerate of the rest of the home. That matters when your only bathroom or your kitchen is torn out.

items.title: Work that fits your budget
items.text: One homeowner says we took time to listen and work with them within their budget. The bathroom went so well that they started additional projects with us.

about.text: Joseph's Constructor LLC is a family-owned remodeling company based on Parkside Avenue in Ewing Township, NJ. The crew remodels bathrooms and kitchens and handles flooring, painting, doors and railings. Kim is the name clients mention most, for keeping planning, ordering and updates easy. In replies to reviews, the owners describe their mission as giving their best as a business, as workers and as people, from the beginning of a job to the end. Clients say they never felt difficult for raising a concern or asking for a change.

items.name: Kim G.
items.text: We saw reviews on Facebook via a local group for Joseph's Constructor LLC and decided to outreach for a quote and bathroom renovation. We had a bathroom redone and we are so happy with the results! They took time to listen and work with us within our budget. The communication was great and was kept open on a regular/daily basis as needed. We actually have started to work with them on additional projects due to our very positive experience. They are family owned and local which is a bonus!

items.name: Rebecca H.
items.text: Joseph’s Constructor was an absolute pleasure to work with and I look forward to hiring them for my next project! Kim made the planning and ordering process so simple and stress free. The crew was super respectful, efficient and extremely neat and considerate of the rest of my home. Whenever I raised a concern or requested a change, Kim consistently responded with patience and professionalism, and never made me feel as though I was being difficult or burdensome. This company went above and beyond and I will never need to look for another contractor. I will absolutely recommend them to everyone I know!

items.name: Jamie S.
items.text: Kim and the team were excellent! Our project took a little over 2 weeks to complete (flooring, kitchen renovation, painting, new doors, new railing, etc.) and the crew was amazing, punctual and super respectful of our space! Kim was super communicative and walked us through each step of the process. We are so thrilled with how everything turned out and the process could not have been easier! We highly recommend Joseph’s for home renovations!

service_area.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Ewing Township, NJ and nearby
service_area.text: Joseph's Constructor is based at 1559 Parkside Ave. in Ewing Township, NJ, and many clients find us through Google and local Facebook groups. If you live near Ewing and want to know whether your home is in range, call (609) 665-8195 with your town and a short description of the bathroom, kitchen or floor you have in mind. We are open Monday through Saturday.

items.a: Yes. Bathrooms are the work we are known for: tiled walk-in showers with recessed niches and benches, tub and shower combinations with glass panels, new vanities with quartz tops, lighting, mirrors and tile floors. Three of our Google reviews call out bathroom renovation by name.
We are open Monday from 7 AM to 6 PM, Tuesday and Wednesday from 6 AM to 6 PM, Thursday from 7 AM to 6 PM, Friday from 6 AM to 6 PM and Saturday from 8 AM to 4 PM. We are closed on Sunday.

items.q: Can you work within my budget?
items.a: Tell us your budget at the start. One client who asked us for a quote on a bathroom says we took time to listen and work with them within their budget, and they were so happy with the result that they hired us for more projects.

items.q: How long does a renovation take?
items.a: It depends on the scope. As one example, a client's project that included flooring, a kitchen renovation, painting, new doors and a new railing took a little over two weeks. We will talk through your timeline when we look at the space.

items.q: How do I get an estimate?
items.a: Call (609) 665-8195 during business hours or email josephsconstructor@gmail.com with a short description and a few photos of the room. From there we can arrange a time to see the space in person, hear what you want and talk through a quote that fits your budget.

final_cta.h2: Ready for a bathroom you love walking into?
final_cta.text: Call Joseph's Constructor Monday through Saturday and tell us what you have in mind.
